features: Adds shared adaptive ProjectionLayoutService for Test and Real Live Screen workflows
Custom format accepts actual LED width and height such as 3840 x 1080
Adds Maximum Density, Auto and Large Cards layout choices with Maximum Density as default
Maximum Density prioritizes minimum page count while adapting row and column geometry to screen aspect ratio
Mirrors screen-format and density controls into both Real and Test Projection Control
Projection URLs carry the selected format, density and custom resolution settings
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
